comment: Pinned third-party runtime binaries for LOCAL transcription (v0.4.5). The executables are NOT stored in git (size); scripts/fetch-binaries.js downloads them from the pinned URLs below and verifies every SHA-256 before a build is packaged. The five Microsoft runtime DLLs ARE in git (small, redistributable) so whisper.exe never dies with 'MSVCP140.dll was not found' on a clean machine. Models are never here: they download on first use into userData.

msvcRuntime.comment: Official Microsoft Visual C++ v14 runtime DLLs (x64), extracted from Microsoft's vc_redist.x64.exe (VS 2022, bundle build 2025-06-11). They sit NEXT TO the whisper executables so Windows loads them privately — no system install, no admin, no missing-DLL errors. vcomp140.dll is included because ggml-cpu.dll imports it (OpenMP). Redistribution is permitted under Microsoft's Visual C++ Redistributable terms.
